mapper.sql: select r.erc_id as recordId, r.erc_status as status, r.erc_pass_status as passStatus, r.erc_total_score as totalScore, r.erc_candidate_id as talId, t.tal_user_id as candidateUserId, s.esd_id as scheduleId, s.esd_position_id as positionId, s.esd_paper_id as paperId, s.esd_pass_threshold as passThreshold, s.esd_auto_flow_json as autoFlow, p.epa_name as paperName, p.epa_total_score as paperTotalScore, pos.pos_title as positionTitle, pos.pos_company_id as companyId, date_format(r.erc_submit_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as submitAt, res.ers_objective_score as objectiveScore, res.ers_subjective_score as subjectiveScore, res.ers_comment as comment from t_exam_record r join t_exam_schedule s on s.esd_id = r.erc_schedule_id join t_exam_paper p on p.epa_id = s.esd_paper_id join t_pos pos on pos.pos_id = s.esd_position_id join t_tal t on t.tal_id = r.erc_candidate_id left join t_exam_result res on res.ers_record_id = r.erc_id where r.erc_id = #{recordId}
mapper.select: select a.ean_id as eanId, a.ean_question_id as questionId, q.eqs_type as type, a.ean_content as content, q.eqs_answer as stdAnswer, a.ean_max_score as maxScore, a.ean_score as score from t_exam_answer a join t_exam_question q on q.eqs_id = a.ean_question_id where a.ean_record_id = #{recordId} order by a.ean_id
mapper.update: update t_exam_record set erc_status = #{status}, erc_total_score = #{totalScore}, erc_pass_status = #{passStatus}, erc_updated_at = now() where erc_id = #{recordId}
mapper.insert: insert into t_exam_result (ers_record_id, ers_objective_score, ers_subjective_score, ers_total_score, ers_pass_status, ers_comment) values (#{recordId}, #{objectiveScore}, #{subjectiveScore}, #{totalScore}, #{passStatus}, #{comment}) on duplicate key update ers_objective_score = values(ers_objective_score), ers_subjective_score = values(ers_subjective_score), ers_total_score = values(ers_total_score), ers_pass_status = values(ers_pass_status), ers_comment = values(ers_comment), ers_updated_at = now()
mapper.select: select a.ean_id as eanId, q.eqs_id as questionId, q.eqs_type as type, q.eqs_content as content, q.eqs_options_json as optionsJson, q.eqs_answer as stdAnswer, a.ean_content as answer, a.ean_max_score as maxScore, a.ean_is_correct as isCorrect, a.ean_score as score from t_exam_answer a join t_exam_question q on q.eqs_id = a.ean_question_id where a.ean_record_id = #{recordId} order by a.ean_id
